Ice & Frost VFX for Godot 4 (code name GLACILUX Lite) - credits and provenance

BattleMage OpenGL 3.3 C++ / GLSL Adaptation:
  Adapted from GLACILUX Lite v1.0.8 (glacilux_meshes.gd, glacilux_projectile_3d.gd,
  glacilux_impact_3d.gd, glacilux_noise.gdshaderinc, glacilux_spike.gdshader,
  glacilux_trail.gdshader, glacilux_shards.gdshader, glacilux_ground.gdshader,
  glacilux_mist.gdshader, glacilux_sparkle.gdshader) into BattleMage's OpenGL 3.3
  instanced renderer (posibleProyecto/IceLanceVFX.h, posibleProyecto/IceLanceVFX.cpp,
  posibleProyecto/shaders.cpp).

Original Pack Notes:
- All GDScript code and shaders in the original pack were written specifically for it.
  Techniques are standard, first-principles graphics methods: integer hashing, value
  noise, fBm, ridged noise and voronoi written from scratch in the shaders; camera-facing
  billboards, prisms and convex chunks; analytic ballistic paths with bounces for the shards.
- No external textures, image files or imported meshes are used by the effect.
